arguments.text: The sky was so clear last night I couldn't stop looking up. I keep turning it over in my head, wondering if anyone else here even notices things like that, or if it's just me. I don't want to keep it to myself anymore. Everyone's close enough to hear me right now — maybe it's time I just said it out loud instead of sitting on it.
